exposure: vaginally delivered babies whose mothers underwent antibiotic prophylaxis
babies who were not breastfed during the neonatal period
cohort: 596 full-term babies born in UK hospitals
finding: Mode of delivery significantly affects gut microbiota composition throughout the neonatal period and into infancy.
mod_finding: Babies delivered by caesarean section had disrupted transmission of maternal Bacteroides strains and high-level colonization by opportunistic pathogens.
